response.edited_text:
Well, the greenhouse has finally stopped pretending to be a sieve. I replaced the cracked pane on Saturday, with Len holding the frame and offering advice at a volume usually reserved for football. We got there. The tomatoes now have a roof, and I have a thumb that is only slightly cross with me.

You asked whether the spare panes would be useful. Two would, if you still have them. I measured the frame this morning: each opening is 28 by 35 centimetres. Please do not make a special trip. I can pick them up after my shift on Wednesday.

And yes, I know I should have fixed it before the rain. The tomatoes have already lodged their complaint; you can add yours at the next meeting.
